note: In Cypress Hills Provincial Park on Elkwater Lake, 20 km southeast of Medicine Hat on Hwy 1 and 30 km south on Hwy 41. The lower loops are an open meadow with lakeside sites and close lake access; many sites in the upper loops are surrounded by trees. Boat launch and playground; firewood is sold in Elkwater townsite. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (updated May 28, 2026), booking site and campground map read. Confirmed 65 unserviced at $31 and 61 power at $39, season May 13 - Oct 11 (2026), 30-amp, flush toilets, showers, all reservable. Wrote max length, no water or sewer hookup, vault toilets, potable taps. No dump station in this campground. Lakefront supported for the lower loop's outer sites.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, supported): agency: 'the lower loop offers close lake access and lakeside sites in an open meadow'. The booking site tags AA 101-107, AA 115 and AA 116 'Near Water'. On Esri imagery the outer spurs of the lower loop (Loop AA; five of them hold the green-roofed huts) end on open mown grass about 20-50 m from the shoreline, with no road and only scattered trees between (0.44 m/px crop; the loop road is on the inside); the loop's west-end spurs are 60-100 m back; Loops C-E are 0.6 km south in forest (imagery estimates).

WHICH CAMPGROUND: the entry is Firerock alone (Loops A, AA, B at the lake and C, D, E 0.6 km up the same road, one entrance). The pin 49.66284,-110.31486 is between Loops A/AA and B; no move. The park's other campgrounds on the booking site (Elkwater, Beaver Creek, Lakeview, Old Baldy, Ferguson Hill, Lodgepole, Reesor Lake, Battle Creek) already have entries 8876-8884. Not in the database: Spruce Coulee (9 tent-only sites) and Spring Creek Equestrian (9 equestrian sites), neither a candidate.

WEBSITE: the second line, https://reservation.albertaparks.ca, is the old reservation address; the park's booking page is https://shop.albertaparks.ca/camping/cypress-hills-provincial-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=ABPP&parkId=330135.
PHONE: page gives '403-893-3833 EXT: 5' (Elkwater visitor centre); the stored number lacks the extension.
PAGE DISAGREES WITH ITSELF: prose says '67 unserviced and 64 powered sites'; the table and booking site say 65 and 61 (the five huts aside).
LENGTH: the 110 ft maximum is site AA 120 on the booking site (AA 118 100 ft, AA 119 90 ft; the rest of Loop AA 60-80 ft); the shortest Firerock site is 25 ft.
DUMP: the park's dump station is at the Elkwater townsite campgrounds on the park map, not in Firerock; facilities.dump left unset.
2027: shop.albertaparks.ca shows the park 'Open year round' at park level; no 2027 Firerock dates are published.
